protection_panel.subtitle: Saved device checks and observation available now.
protection_panel.sign_in_explanation: To test protection, sign in with your usual PIN first. Signing in alone never locks the screen or sends the device to sleep.
protection_panel.start_explanation: You are signed in. Start when you are ready to lock the screen or send this device to sleep.
protection_panel.android_policy: Tokenlogue locks when it leaves the foreground. Use your app PIN to return. Device recovery depends on the security available on this device. The desktop screen lock and sleep tests are unavailable on Android.
